_: Copy to local.json, which is gitignored, then: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=local.json
_url: Simulator or desktop: http://localhost:24275/ . Android emulator: http://10.0.2.2:24275/ . A real device: your machine's LAN IP, and the phone has to be on the same network as the laptop.
_cleartext: Plain http to a LAN address works here because the example allows it in debug builds only (android/app/src/debug/AndroidManifest.xml and the ATS exception in ios/Runner/Info.plist). An app of your own needs its own arrangement, or an https dashboard.
_live: Live sessions and the database browser ride a WebSocket on the same host. Behind nginx that needs Upgrade/Connection forwarded and proxy_buffering off, or pairing hangs with nothing in any log.
CS_PROJECT_ID: the id from the last step of the project wizard
CS_PROJECT_SECRET: the secret from the same screen
